name: Loading screen (wallpaper and title punch)
when: The first scene at app start. Godot's boot splash and the first frame are one plain dark colour (Boot.DARK; the same colour in the project settings and the Android splash, its icon transparent). The dark wallpaper fades in over 0.3 s, then the OUTLAW / SURVIVORS wordmark punches in (no bounce), while the title loads on a thread; once the hit has settled (about 1.02 s) the title is built under the screen and the screen dissolves (0.25 s) into it, never before 1.15 s. Nothing pauses; no input. The same screen also plays on the way into every run (see Revolver wipe).
purpose: Show that the game is loading, without an icon or a bar: the moving wallpaper is the progress indicator.
shows: Six vertical strips of dark saloon wallpaper in two tones with pinstripes and beads, printed tone-on-tone with silhouettes of revolvers, sheriff stars, bombs, boots and other western and game items (tools/make_loading_wallpaper.py -> art/ui/loading/)
The strips scroll in turn up and down at 46 px/s while the whole set drifts right at 15 px/s
The wordmark plate: OUTLAW / SURVIVORS, resting with its middle at 46% of the screen's height

The punch: the plate arriving from 2.6 times its size, zoom-blurred, with speed lines closing in on it; a white impact frame; the screen shaking; a shockwave ring bending the wallpaper; dust and chips flying off its edges; a glint across the letters
rules: The plate slams in at 0.3 s and hits its rest at 0.42 s (0.12 s, faster and faster, never past its size and never back: no squash, no bounce). The hit: the flash held 0.05 s (the hit-stop), then fading; a 22 px shake dying out over 0.3 s; from the end of the hit-stop the ring runs 0.42 s, the dust 0.5 s and the chips 0.55 s; the ui_stamp thud over a low boom (w_lob_boom, 8 dB down); the glint 0.18 s after the hit for 0.38 s. Everything is over at 1.02 s; the title is built only after that, and the dissolve never starts before 1.15 s (BALANCING.md 60.LOAD, 61.LOADUI).

If the threaded load stalls for 10 s the title is loaded directly; if it cannot load at all a rock-red line says 'The title screen did not load. Please close the game and start it again.', the wallpaper stops moving and the screen stays.
Everything is one shader over one full-screen rect, so the dissolve fades every pixel evenly.
The camera-cutout ink band (CutoutBand autoload) waits while this shows and fades in with the title.
states: the hit (impact frame, shake, ring, chips)

name: PLAY DATA ("A quick word")
when: Over the title, 0.8 s after it comes in (TitleScreen.gd:246, CONSENT_DELAY), the first time a build that can send analytics starts and the question has not been answered (Analytics.consent_needed()). Closes on an answer; the back gesture leaves it unanswered and it comes again next launch.
purpose: Ask once whether anonymous play data may be sent (PostHog).

controls.name: NO THANKS
controls.does: Declines: nothing is sent and anything waiting is deleted (Analytics.answer_consent(false)). The answer is kept in the save, through a wipe.

controls.name: OK
controls.does: Accepts: what waited is sent. From then on Settings' 'Anonymous play data' switch is the answer.

controls.name: Dim around the card
controls.does: Does nothing: the card wants an answer.

shows: Star line 'A quick word', title PLAY DATA

Body (WConsent.body_text): what is sent (the items you pick, where you fall, how smoothly it runs), that you appear only as your generated player name (e.g. 'Lanky Tinker 24'), that it asks a few questions after a run now and then, and that both can be turned off in Settings
rules: Until answered nothing is sent or written to disk (Analytics.awaiting_consent).
Not shown at all when the build's analytics key file is empty.

name: Revolver wipe (into a run)
purpose: Carry the player from a menu into a run without a blank frame: the run loads behind the loading screen.
when: Every way into a run: START, a Stages card, PLAY AGAIN, the arena. The screen left is seen through a revolver's cylinder, end on, that closes on the middle of the screen while it turns until it is dark (0.5 s, the cylinder's spin sound). The loading screen comes out of the dark through the same opening (0.3 s) as the wordmark punches in; the run loads meanwhile and is built under it once the hit has settled. From 1.15 s, once the run has drawn, the cylinder opens from the hero's spawn beam onto the run (0.4 s).

controls.name: Any touch
controls.does: Nothing: no tap goes through until it opens.

shows: The cylinder's five chambers cut out of the dark, turning
The loading screen in the middle of the sequence
The cylinder opening on the spawn beam
rules: If the run's scene cannot load, a line says 'The run did not load. Back to the title.' and the player goes back.

controls.does: Closes the sheet.

controls.does: As on the title, with UPGRADE open; opening the board clears its red crumb.

shows: Header UPGRADE, the back square and the purse
YOU HOLD: a chip a rank in the icon of its form, or a hint when empty

A 2-column grid of talent tiles: the name, 'Rank n / 7', both forms with what a rank gives, a rank bar of seven slots (a bought rank shows its form's icon, an unbought one is dashed), and CHOOSE with the next price
The sheet: RANK r OF 7, the name, the flavour, the rank bar large, 'Rank r of 7 owned · <effects>', each form's icon, name, what a rank gives (with the rank-7 step) and 'n owned'
rules: Eight talents, two forms, seven ranks each; every rank is bought in one form and keeps it; the board sorted by first-rank price.
Rank k costs k x k times rank 1 (rank 7: 49 times). The seventh rank gives that form's step x 1.5 (x2 on whole numbers: Reroll, Banish, Skip +2).

Forms, a rank: Grit: Padding (+10% max HP a rank, +15% at rank 7) / Plate (+6% damage reduction a rank, +9% at rank 7: every hit lands lighter); Drive: Muscle (+8% attack damage a rank, +12% at rank 7) / Tempo (-6% cooldown a rank, -9% at rank 7); Stride: Boots (+5% move speed a rank, +7.5% at rank 7) / Lodestone (+18% pickup reach a rank, +27% at rank 7); Study: Field Notes (+10% XP a rank, +15% at rank 7) / Poultice (+0.3 regen a rank, +0.45 at rank 7 (it still waits after a hit)); Fortune: Omen (+0.12 luck a rank, +0.18 at rank 7: rarer items turn up more often) / Greed (+12% gold a rank, +18% at rank 7); Choice: Reroll (+1 reroll a run, a rank; +2 at rank 7) / Banish (+1 banish a stage, a rank; +2 at rank 7); Nerve: Skip (+1 skip a stage, a rank; +2 at rank 7) / Second Wind (+10% health on revive a rank, +15% at rank 7: 40% up to 100%, past that 1 s untouchable for each 10%); Stakes: Difficulty (Creatures +10% HP and attack, +4% speed a rank; half as much again at rank 7) / Boss (Bosses and Elites +10% HP and attack, +4% speed a rank; half as much again at rank 7). Stakes (id spite) also gives a hidden +5% XP and coins a rank.
The board does not scroll under an open sheet.

states: The Dust Bowl (brown filter, fog, haze, a storm of wind)

name: Bounty posters
purpose: Offer a side task for this run: done, it pays extra coins at the end.
when: Right after the spawn beam's landing, on every run started from the menus once a save has played before (never on a first run). The run pauses under a light dim; the three posters drop in on strings from the top of the screen and sway.

controls.name: A poster
controls.does: Takes it: stamped TAKEN, the others fall away, the HUD comes back and the poster flies into the bounty plate under the item row; the run goes on.

controls.name: Re-roll
controls.does: Rolls new posters, when the save has a re-roll.

controls.name: No bounty
controls.does: All three blow away; the run goes on without one.

shows: WANTED and 'Take a bounty for this run. Done, it pays when the run ends.'
Three paper posters on nails, each a task, its numbers, its difficulty and its reward
rules: Tasks, weights and numbers live in content/wanted/wanted.json and the Level Editor's Wanted tab; they scale with progression and never name a locked item, hero or creature.
Results pays the bounty in coins on screen.
Endless grows at a third of its rate while a poster is still open.

name: In-run HUD
when: Whenever a run is playing. It steps aside (hides) while any paused modal is up; the tap-to-continue gate brings it back so the picked card can fly to its slot. Hidden entirely in the run sim's fast mode.
purpose: Everything the player reads while playing, with nothing interactive between y 700 and 1600 except the joystick.

controls.name: Top strip (anywhere on the rail, plates or slots; the pause square at its right)
controls.does: Pauses: opens the pause screen (HUD.pause_requested -> Game.open_pause). PlayerInput's thumb zone starts just below the strip (HUD.band_h).

controls.name: Anywhere below the strip (drag)
controls.does: The floating joystick: a ring (55% ink over a faint paper disc, a paper knob) appears under the thumb and steers the hero; its size follows Settings 'Joystick size'. Keyboard play on PC draws none.

shows: XP rail: a 65 px ink rail across the top edge with a purple fill
Top row of plates in the Royale kit: 'LV n' on the left, the clock centred, the run's gold with a coin, the pause square on the right
Kill counter under the clock (WKillCount): a jawless skull and the run's kills, ding-sized by the kill rate, with no sound

Mutation-next mark: while a mutation offer is due and a weapon has a pick open (Run.mutlvl_pending) the LV plate turns mutation plum with paper letters and 'MUTATION NEXT' sits at the XP rail's end (HUD.gd:315)

Clock plate modes: the stage's own time; while the portal waits, the seconds left before Endless on red with 'ENDLESS IN' under it (pulsing in its last seconds); in Endless the time survived in it on ink with 'WAVE n' under it (HUD.gd:1264)
Bounty plate on the right under the item row while a Wanted poster is taken: the task and how far along it is

Slots: 5 weapon slots from the left, 5 card slots from the right, 72 px each; a held item is its frame in its level's rarity colour with a level tag (and a weapon's mutation dots, glowing when it waits to evolve); empty slots are see-through. Passive items are not on the HUD (the pause Build tab lists them)

Power-up plates under the slots: green plates with the seconds left for timed pickups (Berserk, Sprint, the Magnet power-up...) and Pollen; the War Drum's boost on its drum red (structure buffs with params.plate; HUD.gd:1003)
Build-up words under the plates: Adrenaline stacks, Crescendo, Steady Hand, Gas Mask's reduction, SKEDADDLE, Hot Streak's damage (HUD.buff_parts)
Boss name (paper slab with ink outline, its badge) and HP bar while a boss lives (Game: director.boss_started -> HUD.show_boss)
Toasts under all that (WToasts): one at a time, 1.2 s each, in green (health), purple (XP) or paper; some carry an icon (a Totem spirit's face)
Banner at 38% of the screen height for 2 s (WBanner): BOSS DOWN, EVOLVED · NAME (orange, with icon), UNLOCKED: NAME, A NEW HERO IS FOR SALE, ENDLESS (red), PHOENIX FEATHER, REVIVED, DICE: ...

Edge pointers (WPointer): a paper tag on the left or right edge with a triangle in the target's colour and its name and distance, for the boss (red), the portal (green) and the Elite (orange) while they are off screen
The hero's bars under him (HP, shield, Snake Oil's overheal past full in pink); a hit jiggles the bars sideways instead of shaking the screen (HUD.shake_hp_bar)
'+N XP' and '+N' gold with a coin rising from the hero (batched over a quarter second)
A full-screen colour flash for the nuke or a harpoon hit
rules: The strip sits W.safe_top() lower on a phone with a camera cutout; a long arena build splits the slots into two rows and makes the strip taller.
First-play hints sit in the toast slot (see hints).
No hero gauge for any hero since pass 69.

name: First-play hints
when: In the first 30 s of a run while Settings 'First-play hints' is on, each once per save (Save.hint ids).
purpose: Teach the controls without a tutorial.
shows: 'Drag anywhere to walk' until the hero moves
'He shoots by himself' ('She shoots by herself' / 'They shoot by themselves' by the hero's pronoun) for a few seconds after
'The purple is XP' until the first gem (gives up after a while)
'Tap the pause button for your build' at 1:30 of a run (once, Hints.gd:102)
After the first Totem gift: 'Totem gifts last the whole run'
On the level-up screen the dry line reads 'Pick one. The plate's colour says what it is.' on a save's first offers (CardScreen.HINT_LINE); banish mode's first use explains more
rules: Shown in the HUD's toast slot; Settings 'Show the hints again next run: Reset' forgets them.

name: Floating numbers
when: During play, each kind while its Settings switch is on (Damage / Heal / XP / Coin numbers). Frozen while paused, hidden while a modal is up.
purpose: Show damage dealt and taken and healing, MMO style.
shows: Creature hits: white numbers at the hit point (orange for fire ticks, purple for poison); crits big and yellow with a hop, mini crits paler
On the hero: damage taken in red and shield soak in blue on his left, healing in green on his right, EVADE and BLOCK words
Merging: hits on one creature close together add into one number; past 40 on screen they thin (pass 102); at most CAP live
rules: Size from Settings 'Floating text size' (Small / Normal / Large).
A hit off screen gets no number.

name: Level-up cards
when: Each level the hero gains, requested through Game's one-screen rule (Modal.CARDS, priority 30; Game.gd:1825). The run pauses; levels gained meanwhile are banked and shown one after another. A level with nothing left to offer pays +10 gold instead ('Nothing left to pick. +10 gold'). Closes on a pick, a skip; then the tap-to-continue gate.
purpose: Choose one of three upgrades: a new item or the next level of one held.

controls.name: Item card (one of three)
controls.does: Takes it (CardPool.apply); the card is remembered so the gate flies it to its HUD slot. A held card sits on its shadow with a gold band.

controls.name: REROLL ×N
controls.does: A fresh set of three; uses one reroll (1 a run by default, +1 a rank of Choice/Reroll). Ends banish mode. At 0: 'No rerolls left. The Choice upgrade gives more.' (CardScreen.gd:961).

controls.name: SKIP ×N
controls.does: Closes with nothing; uses one of the stage's skips (2 a stage, shared with chests and mutation offers; Nerve/Skip adds). At 0: 'No skips left this stage.'

controls.name: BANISH ×N
controls.does: Enters banish mode: the title turns to a red BANISH (star line 'Strike one off'), a line explains ('Tap a new item to strike it from this run. It will not be offered again.'; longer the first time), cards that may go wear a red BANISH stamp, items already held are dimmed 'YOU HAVE THIS', an evolution of a held item 'EVOLVES YOURS'. Tap a card to strike it: stamped BANISHED, a replacement drops in, one banish used (1 a stage by default). Locked at 0 or when nothing on the table can go ('Nothing here can be banished: you already have all of these.').

controls.name: CANCEL (BANISH in banish mode)
controls.does: Leaves banish mode.

controls.name: A refused card in banish mode
controls.does: Shakes and says why: 'You have X: banishing it would lock its upgrades.', 'X evolves what you have: it can't be banished.', 'X is a mutation: mutations can't be banished.', 'Gold cannot be banished.'

controls.name: debug (small button bottom right; developer 'Debug buttons on modals' or player debug mode)
controls.does: Opens the debug hand.

shows: A rainbow full XP rail along the top edge
Star line 'Level up', the title 'LEVEL N' over a turning shine, a sunburst and confetti on entry, the dry line 'Pick one. The desert waits.'

Three item cards dropping in one after another: item frame in its rarity (a radial fill, a rainbow rim on the top ones; mutations' frame has its own cut corners and rose rim), kind word, name, level stars, one effect line; a tag UPGRADE (green) / NEW (gold) / EVOLUTION; an upgrade lists its changes ('Damage 12 -> 15') and its new stars pulse; the hero's favourite has a heart and the word FAVOURITE
Bottom row REROLL ×N · SKIP ×N · BANISH ×N
rules: Always three cards (luck only changes rarity odds; pass 52).
Skips and banishes refill at every stage start (Run.refill_choices, Run.gd:1002); rerolls are per run.
Never offered: banished items, quest-locked items not held, hidden items, other heroes' own weapons, stage-3-only items before stage 3, a weapon's base once it has evolved (BALANCING.md).
A long list shrinks to fit above the buttons; layout under the camera cutout.
A first-time player gets the Dynamite among the cheapest cards at the first level-4 card screen of every run, until it has been picked once (FtueDynamite).
No legendary passive item before 4:30 of a stage, from any source (LegendaryHold).

name: TAP TO GO (resume gate)
when: After a level-up pick, a mutation pick or a chest closes and no other screen waits (Game._modal_done through_gate, Game.gd:1100). The shop, the Stranger, the Totem, the drum, the portal and Down! resume without it.
purpose: Let the player re-grip before the run goes on, and show where the pick went.

controls.name: Any touch
controls.does: Resumes the run (with 1 s of blinking invulnerability) and the same touch can start the joystick. A touch on the HUD strip is kept by the gate so it does not also open the pause.

shows: The dim lifting from 78% to 40%
The picked card shrinking and flying (turning -8 degrees) into its HUD slot, which takes a gold border and level tag (a passive flies into the pause square)
'TAP TO GO' and 'Still paused. They'll wait.' at y 1500
rules: Not a screen of its own, but it counts as one for the one-screen rule (a request waits for the tap).

name: Pick a mutation (mutation level-up)
when: A mutation offer falls due on the stage's path_times and replaces the hero's next level-up's three cards (Run.mutlvl_*; Game._mutlvl_open, Game.gd:1901); the HUD's MUTATION NEXT mark warns of it. Also through Modal.PATH (priority 20) for tools. The run pauses; closes on a pick or a skip, then the gate.
purpose: Take one of a weapon's path mutations (its three paths lead to its evolution).

controls.name: Weapon reel (WWeaponReel)
controls.does: Runs first: the hero's weapons with an open path slide past a gold window, ticking and slowing, and stop on the weapon picked at random (Run.next_path_weapon); a single weapon only wobbles. A tap anywhere skips to the landing; a second tap goes on at once.

controls.name: Mutation card
controls.does: Takes that mutation (CardPool.apply); toast in mutation purple.

controls.name: SKIP ×N (single, centred)
controls.does: Closes with nothing; uses one of the stage's skips ('Mutation skipped'). At 0: 'No skips left this stage.'

shows: Head: 'Pick a mutation', the weapon's frame (shine behind it once the reel lands), its name, the word 'Mutation' with its rivets (taken / offered) and 'the others come back next stage'
The mutation cards under it, in the mutations' own frame (cut corners, near-black face, rose rim)
The rainbow XP rail, full
rules: No REROLL or BANISH here; mutations can never be banished.
All three path mutations plus the weapon at level 5 = its evolution at a chest.

name: Chest (★ LOOT ★) and Mutation chest (★ A PATH OPENS ★)
when: Touching a chest on the ground (a special's sure drop, a regular creature's rare one, the crowned Elites' purple chest, which holds a mutation reel; a boss leaves its own, see Boss chest) -> Game.open_chest. The run pauses. Closes on TAKE IT or SKIP, then the gate.
purpose: The run's reward moment: a slot-machine reel lands on one item.

controls.name: Tap during the chest's opening
controls.does: Skips to the spin.

controls.name: Tap during a spin
controls.does: Hurries the rest into 0.6 s.

controls.name: TAKE IT
controls.does: Takes the landed item (Run.chest_take); toast 'Chest: <line>'.

controls.name: SKIP ×N
controls.does: Closes with nothing; uses one of the stage's skips ('Chest skipped'). Locked on gold ('Gold goes straight into the purse.') and at 0 ('No skips left this stage.'); with no skip the chest cannot be let go.

controls.name: BANISH ×N
controls.does: Strikes the landed item from the run (Run.chest_banish) and the reel spins again (~2 s) to a new roll, the chest staying open. Only a new item can go: refused with 'Gold cannot be banished.', 'An evolution cannot be banished.', 'A mutation cannot be banished.', 'You have X. Only new items can be banished.' At 0: 'No banishes left this stage.'

shows: Star line 'Loot' and CHEST in cream (a purple chest: 'A path opens' and MUTATION CHEST, violet light)
The chest (WChest) dropping in on the lower third, knocking three times and throwing its lid open, its light rising into the reel's row; a turning shine behind it
The reel of plates running sideways for about four seconds and landing; the landed frame grows to 420 px with a glow
Under it: the kind word with UPGRADE / NEW / EVOLUTION tag, the name, the stars (an upgrade's new ones pulse), the effect line or change rows; GOLD: 'Straight into the purse.'; the favourite's heart
SKIP ×N · BANISH ×N · TAKE IT
rules: A purple chest's reel runs past the open paths only (mutations).
Slot-machine sounds: lever, spin loop, clunk, jackpot (WSlotSound).
The HUD steps aside.

name: Boss chest
when: Touching the chest a boss leaves where it fell, each boss its own: the King's Chest, Gila's Hoard, Collection Box, Brander's Coffer -> Game.open_boss_chest. The run pauses. Closes on CLAIM, straight back to the run (no gate).
purpose: Pay out everything the boss's kill is worth in gold and XP, times a bonus for a fast kill, as one big celebration.

controls.name: Tap before the burst
controls.does: Skips the knocks to the lid bursting open.

controls.name: Tap during the spew
controls.does: Finishes the count in 0.9 s.

controls.name: CLAIM
controls.does: Shows once every piece has landed. Pays exactly the two counters (gold with greed in, XP with Field Notes in), closes; back in the world the coins and gems burst out of the chest's spot and fly to the hero with everything else on the map.

shows: Star line 'Boss chest' and the chest's name
SPEED BONUS plate: the multiplier (x1 to x2), 'Killed in m:ss' ('· faster pays more' at x1), a gauge from x1 to the map's top with this kill's mark
The boss's painted chest dropping in, knocking four times, cracking on a light, bursting open with a white flash, a screen shake, rays in the boss's colour and gold, confetti and 'BOSS LOOT!'

Coins and XP gems arcing out of it into GOLD and EXP counters at the bottom, slowly then faster and faster, each landing with a ding and a sparkle; the banner climbing BIG WIN!, HUGE WIN!, MEGA WIN!; coins raining down; JACKPOT! with bursts over the counters
CLAIM
rules: The faster the kill, the more it holds and the longer it spews (BALANCING 60.BOSSCHEST: x2 up to 1.5 x the boss's least fight, x1 from 4 x; the boss's seconds are 40, 60, 70 and 80 in the map).
A jackpot slot-machine tune loops all the while, its pitch climbing with the spew; the run's music steps back under it.
The purple chest (a mutation reel) is the crowned Elites' since pass 118; a stage that ends with no boss still leaves it.
The HUD steps aside.

name: The Shop
when: Using the shop structure on the map (stand in its ring until its pie fills; StructureManager) -> Modal.SHOP (priority 10; Game.gd:2290). The run pauses. Empty offer: '+50 gold' toast instead. Closes on a purchase or LEAVE (or Esc on PC); the run resumes straight (no gate).
purpose: Spend the run's gold on one of three items.

controls.name: Item card (price is the button)
controls.does: Buys it if the run's gold covers it (Run.spend_gold, sink 'shop'); toast 'Bought!'. One purchase and the stall is spent. A card you cannot afford is aged at 60% with '· N short' and plays the locked sound.

controls.name: LEAVE
controls.does: Closes without buying; the stall is spent too.

shows: Star line 'One visit only', THE SHOP, the run's gold
YOU HOLD: a wrapping row of frames for every weapon and passive held
Three item cards with their prices
rules: Prices are about half a stage's gold (by stage; Endless stays on the stage's own) x kind (weapon > line > passive/perk) x rarity x (1 + a step per level held) (StructureShop.price_of).
The stack shrinks to fit above LEAVE under a camera cutout.
states: long build tray (two rows, smaller plates)

name: The Stranger
when: Using the hooded figure structure -> Modal.STRANGER (priority 10; Game.gd:2269). The run pauses. Empty offer: '+60 gold' instead ('The Stranger had nothing for you.'). Closes on DEAL or WALK AWAY; the run resumes straight.
purpose: A bargain: one item for a share of max HP for the rest of the run.

controls.name: DEAL
controls.does: Takes the item and pays the HP (Run.stranger_take); toast 'The deal: <line>, for N% of your health'.

controls.name: WALK AWAY
controls.does: Refuses; toast 'The Stranger is gone. Only his cloak stays.'

shows: Plum-black dim, star line 'No name', THE STRANGER
His cut-out holding the item (placeholder until art/ui/wanted/stranger.png exists) and the quote '“A piece of you, for a piece of the world.”'
The deal panel: the item as a card; 'The price · max HP for the rest of the run' as a bar losing its end, 'max -> new max'; 'No reroll. No second offer. He does not haggle.'
rules: Either way he is gone afterwards (only the cloak stays on the sand).
The HP cost is a fraction of max HP (offer.hp_cost, default 0.15).
Under a camera cutout the panel rises and the portrait shrinks so nothing runs under the buttons.

name: Spirit Pole (★ TOTEM k OF n ★)
when: Using a Totem Pole (10-12 a map) -> Modal.TOTEM (priority 10; Game.gd:2379). The pole's ring flashes, the run pauses. A pole with nothing to offer only shows its name. Closes on a pick (no way out otherwise); the run resumes straight.
purpose: Pick one of three small permanent-for-the-run stat gifts.

controls.name: Gift row (its carved segment and its tag)
controls.does: Takes that gift (Run.take_totem_boon): the chosen face flies to the toast slot, the rest drops away; toast '<Spirit> · +2% move speed' with the face.

controls.name: Anywhere else
controls.does: Nothing; there is no close button. Dragging off a held row cancels the press.

shows: '★ TOTEM k OF n ★' (this gift's count of the map's poles)
A carved pole on the left: the thunderbird crest on top, three spirit segments with carved faces on a cedar post
A nailed paper tag beside each: the amount big with its stat ('+2%' 'move speed'), the spirit ('Le-loo, the Wolf'), a row of stars showing which third of its range the roll landed in
rules: The pole greys as the gift is taken.
Gifts stack for the run (Run.totem_boons); the first one taught by the hint 'Totem gifts last the whole run'.

name: War Drum moment
when: Using the War Drum structure -> Modal.DRUM (priority 35, before the level cards; Game.gd:2337). Time stops: the run pauses, every sound effect stops and the music holds. Lasts params.moment.seconds (2.2 s), then the boost starts and the run resumes straight.
purpose: A short drum show that announces a 15 s boost.

controls.name: Any touch
controls.does: Swallowed while it plays (counted in touches_eaten); it cannot be skipped by the player.

shows: The drum (cut from its painting) fading in centre screen, squashing and springing on each slap, waves and ink slap lines from each hit; the last big hit flashes the screen and brings in the boost in words (DrumBoost.summary: e.g. '×2 DAMAGE · ×2 ATTACK SPEED · +15% SPEED' plus knockback)
After it: a red HUD plate counting the boost's seconds, and a toast '<NAME>: 15 s'
rules: The boost (DrumBoost): x2 damage and attack speed, knockback, +15% speed for 15 s; halved where Rage or Sprint already boost (params.stack).
The run sim and an ended run take the boost without the moment.

name: Grindstone moment
purpose: The show for the Grindstone's one deed: a weapon sharpened a level, or evolved.
when: The first weapon level-up after the Grindstone is held, once a run. Time stops as with the drum. Lasts 3 s for a level, 3.5 s for an evolution.

controls.name: A tap
controls.does: Hurries the show after a short guard (0.3 s); recorded in a replay as grind_hurry.

shows: GRINDSTONE and 'SHARPENING THE <WEAPON>' over a dusk dim
A wheel drawn in code turning on its stand, the weapon's icon held to it, sparks flying
The reveal: the weapon's frame, its stars, 'LEVEL n > n+1', or EVOLVED with the evolution's frame and 'from the <weapon>'
rules: The Grindstone is a one-shot: one level, once a run, '(used)' on the pause screen afterwards. It levels the weakest weapon, or evolves one that is ready.
Timings and sounds in the item's params.grind.moment.

name: PAUSED
when: A tap on the HUD's top strip or pause square, Esc on PC, or the app going to the background (Game.gd:1238). Not during the spawn beam, after the run ended, or while another screen is up. The Android back gesture in a run is ignored (only logged). Closes on RESUME (or Esc).
purpose: Look at the build and the stats, change a few options, or abandon the run.

controls.name: Tabs: Build / Stats / Options
controls.does: Switch the board.

controls.name: Build: an item row
controls.does: Opens on its numbers (a stat grid), its mutation chips and what evolving still needs.

controls.name: Stats: a stat cell
controls.does: Opens its sources card: 'At the start' (base, hero, Upgrade board) and 'This run' (cards, items, perks, mutations, levels, Totem gifts, the Stranger, timed buffs) with amounts.

controls.name: Options: Sound / Music sliders
controls.does: As Settings.

controls.name: Options: Screen shake (switch)
controls.does: On = 1.0, off = 0 (a switch here, a 0-150% slider in Settings: turning it on here resets a custom value to 100%).

controls.name: Options: Damage / Heal / XP / Coin numbers, Floating text size
controls.does: As Settings.

controls.name: Options: Abandon (red)
controls.does: Asks 'Abandon the run?' ('The run ends here, and the N gold picked up so far comes home with you.', 'Abandon' / 'Keep playing'); confirmed, the run ends and goes to Results (Game.abandon_run).

controls.name: RESUME
controls.does: Closes the pause; any screen asked for meanwhile comes next.

controls.name: Board (drag)
controls.does: Scrolls.

shows: PAUSED and '<stage clock> · STAGE N' (or 'Endless')
Build: groups Weapons (n / 5), Cards (n / 5), Passives ('n · not on the HUD'), Perks; each row the plate, stars and what it does; a spent once-a-run item (Phoenix Feather) reads '(used)'
Stats: 'Changed this run' count, a breakdown card (max HP by default), two columns of every stat with change pills (green better, red worse) since the run's start
Options: the purse with a coin 'picked up so far is kept · asks first'
rules: The pause screen counts as a screen for the one-screen rule.
Esc closes the abandon question first, then the pause.
states: Stats tab with a source card

name: Last Stand (slowed time overlay)
when: When the Last Stand passive fires (toast 'LAST STAND'): the engine runs slowed for Run.LAST_STAND_SECONDS of real time; it gives the clock back while any screen pauses the run.
purpose: Show the passive's slow-motion damage window.
shows: The world drained to a cold blue-grey with a red rim swelling with a heartbeat (core/shaders/last_stand.gdshader)
rules: Ends at once if the hero falls or the run ends.

name: DOWN! (★ 1 CHANCE LEFT ★)
when: 1.2 s after the hero falls (Game.gd:2793), through Modal.REVIVE, which beats every other screen (priority 70): while he is down only Down! may open; level-ups are banked and chests/offers wait until he stands. Not shown when Phoenix Feather is ready (he stands up by himself, banner PHOENIX FEATHER). The run pauses. Closes on a decision or when the 8 s count runs out (= stay down).
purpose: Revive once (plus Upgrade revives) or end the run.

controls.name: GET UP · WATCH AN AD
controls.does: Revives at the revive_hp share (half, more with Second Wind) with a blast that clears round him (Game._revive); uses a chance. It is a stand-in: no ad plays. Locked when no chance is left ('NO CHANCES LEFT').

controls.name: STAY DOWN (red)
controls.does: Asks 'Stay down?' ('The run ends here, and the N gold comes home with you.', 'Stay down' / 'Not yet'), the count held meanwhile; confirmed, the run ends -> Results.

controls.name: Hit log: hold / copy (debug or developer 'Hit log')
controls.does: hold pauses the count ('go on' resumes); copy puts the last 30 s as text on the clipboard ('copied').

controls.name: Testers only: REVIVE (green, top right) and hold time
controls.does: With the developer 'Free revive button': a free revive that uses no chance, and holding the count.

shows: Rock dim, 'N CHANCE(S) LEFT', DOWN!
A paper disc with the seconds counting down (8) and 'get up'; ticks in the last 3
'<killer> put you down.' with its badge (or 'Something put you down.')
'<clock> · N kills · Lv N'
'Stay down and the <coin> N gold still comes home.'
Debug only: the last 30 s list, newest first: time before the fall, badge, the creature's name in its colour, what it cost or healed, a red X on the fatal hit
rules: One chance a run plus Nerve/Second Wind's revives (1 + revives - used).
There is no gold revive since pass 77.
A death banks the purse like an extraction (pass 70).

name: STAGE N CLEAR (BOSS DOWN)
when: After the stage's boss dies a portal opens (toast 'PORTAL OPEN: extract before Endless') and a 60 s countdown to Endless starts (HUD clock 'ENDLESS IN'). Walking into the portal asks through Modal.PORTAL (priority 60; Game.gd:2658). The run pauses but the countdown keeps running while the dialog is up (Game.tick_portal_countdown). Closes on EXTRACT, NOT YET, back/Esc, or by itself when the countdown ends.
purpose: Leave with the run's gold before Endless, or keep fighting.

controls.name: Extract ('Safe · run ends', the run's gold big in gold)
controls.does: Ends the run as extracted (Save 'extract_<map>_<n>', totals) -> Results.

controls.name: NOT YET (or back / Esc)
controls.does: Closes with no decision; the run goes on, toast 'The portal waits'; the dialog asks again once the hero steps out and walks back in.

shows: Star line 'Boss down' and STAGE N CLEAR, with the time, kills and level
The Extract road: the run's gold, a chest and EXTRACT
The Endless card (not a road): 'Endless', 'Starts in' with the seconds counting down (red in its last seconds), what Endless is, and 'The N gold comes home either way.'
A footer saying what NOT YET means
rules: If the countdown runs out with the dialog up, it closes itself and Endless starts behind it (Game._on_endless_started, Game.gd:2720).
There is no 'continue to the next stage' since pass 87: each stage is its own run.

name: Endless
when: When the portal's countdown ends without an extraction: the portal closes, an ENDLESS banner in red, then a big wave and a stronger one every 10 s until the hero falls (WaveDirector; timeline_data.endless).
purpose: An open-ended score attack after the stage's boss.
shows: Clock plate on ink with the time survived in Endless and 'WAVE n' under it, pulsing on each new wave
rules: Creatures grow in HP, attack and speed each wave and resist non-explosive knockback more over 90 s (HP x1.15 and ATK x1.095 a wave, speed +4% a wave to x2.4; a third of that growth while a Wanted poster is open).
0.35 XP share, rare coins.
The run ends only by death or abandon; Results reads 'Fell in Endless'.

name: Results (★ EXTRACTED ★ / ★ RUN OVER ★ / ★ FELL IN ENDLESS ★)
when: 1.2 s after any run ends (extract, stay down / count out, abandon) (Game.end_run, Game.gd:2965). Back gesture: dismisses a survey card first, else to the title. No header or back square.
purpose: Tell the run's story: the gold banked, the kills and damage over time, and what was unlocked.

controls.name: Anywhere but a button (tap)
controls.does: First tap hurries the sequence playing (SPEED_UP), a second ends it (ResultsScreen.gd:817).

controls.name: PLAY AGAIN
controls.does: Starts the same stage again with the same hero.

controls.name: UPGRADE (blue)
controls.does: Opens the Upgrade board.

controls.name: MAIN MENU
controls.does: Back to the title.

controls.name: Board (drag)
controls.does: Scrolls freely once the show is over (held at the top while the first sequence plays).

shows: Star line (Extracted / Fell in Endless / Run over), the stage line ('STAGE 1 · SUNDOWN · BEATEN') in the stage colour, the run time big, 'Endless m:ss · wave n' when it ran, 'Lv N · N kills · N chests · N evolutions'

Hero panel: his badge (played look), BANKED counting up along the run's purse curve, the purse before and after, a taken bounty paid in coins flying on screen; a NEW BEST seal when the run beat a previous best by 0.5 s (ResultsScreen.gd:222)

Run performance: the kills chart drawn left to right with badges (a grave for each fall, a skull per boss, a crown per Elite, a gear per special), Kills and Damage counters, then 'Damage dealt': a row per source (plate or '?', name, damage number over a share bar, percent) arriving as the line reaches the moment each joined
'Unlocked this run': each unlock landing with an UNLOCKED (or FOR SALE for a hero) stamp; 'Unlock progress': bars filling from where they stood (this run's part in green)
rules: A death and an abandon bank the purse like an extraction (pass 70).
A run of 60 s or more may bring the end-of-run survey 1.4 s after the show ends.
Music mu_results.

name: Survey card ("A quick word")
when: Over the Results screen 1.4 s after its show ends, when Analytics has a survey due (Analytics.survey_after_run: runs of 60 s or more, at most one every 3 counted runs, never twice a session, '[after N]' / '[run N]' tags from PostHog, never in the arena or without consent, Settings 'Questions after a run' on). Also from the developer menu's 'Surveys · show one now'.
purpose: Ask the player a few questions written in PostHog Surveys.

controls.name: Rating numbers / choice buttons / text box
controls.does: Answer the page's question (a rating row with its two labels; single choice; multiple choice 'Pick any that fit.'; a text box 'Type here' that raises the phone keyboard and lifts the card above it).

controls.name: NEXT / SEND
controls.does: NEXT keeps the answer and turns the page; SEND on the last page sends every answer ('survey sent'). Needs an answer unless the question is optional.

controls.name: NOT NOW (or the back gesture)
controls.does: Dismisses; PostHog hears 'survey dismissed'; answers so far are not sent.

controls.name: Don't ask me again (under the card)
controls.does: Dismisses and turns Settings' 'Questions after a run' off (survey_opt_out).

controls.name: Dim
controls.does: Nothing.

shows: Star line 'A quick word', '1 / 3' progress, the question and its line
rules: A finger outside the text box drops its focus (hides the keyboard).

name: Question card (★ HOLD ON ★)
when: Before any deed that cannot be undone: buying a hero or a skin, Reset Upgrades, wiping the save, abandoning the run, staying down, leaving the arena, resetting surveys. One per host; works paused or not.
purpose: The kit's one confirmation pop-up.

controls.name: Way out (slate, left: 'Not now', 'Keep them', 'Keep it', 'Keep playing', 'Not yet', 'Stay', 'Keep')
controls.does: Cancels.

controls.name: The deed (red, gold or green, right)
controls.does: Does it.

controls.name: Dim, back gesture, Esc
controls.does: Cancel.

shows: 'Hold on' star line, the question in Ultra, one plain line on what is lost, the two buttons
rules: Replaced every old 'Sure? Tap again' button (pass 45).

name: Debug hand
when: From the 'debug' button on the level-up screen (developer 'Debug buttons on modals' or the player's debug mode).
purpose: Hand over any weapon, evolution, line, passive, perk or mutation at any level to try a build.

controls.name: Item rows with a level box
controls.does: Tap to choose items and set how many levels of each.

controls.name: Give
controls.does: Hands them over and closes; the offer underneath stays standing.

shows: A list of every item in the game (a line handed over as the passive it is)
rules: Old UiKit look, not the game's kit.

name: Debug panel (in run)
when: In a run when the developer menu's 'Debug panel in run' is on (shown from the start), or toggled with F1 on a PC (not in prod; Game.gd:1233). Not paused.
purpose: Quick cheats while playing.

controls.name: Spawn 50 walkers / Spawn 100 swarmers
controls.does: Spawns packs of the map's 'walker' / 'swarmer' skins (Red Canyon: skeleton, fire_ant) 12 m ahead.

controls.name: Spawn elite / Spawn boss
controls.does: Spawns an Elite / the map's boss.

controls.name: Level up
controls.does: One level.

controls.name: +500 gold
controls.does: Gold.

controls.name: God mode
controls.does: Toggles invulnerability.

controls.name: Kill all
controls.does: Kills every creature.

controls.name: Vacuum
controls.does: Pulls every pickup in.

controls.name: Chest here
controls.does: A chest 2 m ahead.

controls.name: Give random weapon
controls.does: A weapon not held.

controls.name: Max all held
controls.does: Maxes every held item.

shows: 'fps · alive · proj · gems' line
rules: Old UiKit look; its header comment says 'enable in Options', but the switch is in the developer menu.

name: Debug arena (ArenaPanel)
when: From the title's ARENA (player debug mode) or the developer menu's 'Arena'. The map and the hero with nothing coming unless asked ('DEBUG ARENA' banner). The game waits while the bottom sheet is open. Leaving returns to the title; nothing done here reaches the save.
purpose: A test room for every creature, item, hero, look and drop.

controls.name: Quick column (right edge): ARENA / AGAIN / CLEAR / WAVES (HOLD while running) / LV +1
controls.does: Open the sheet; repeat the last spawn; clear every creature and shot; run or hold the real wave director; level the hero. A status line under them.

controls.name: ENEMY tab
controls.does: Every creature by group (roster, specials, Elites, bosses, retired) with how many, where (near, ring, far), an Elite modifier and hold still; a boss comes as a real boss.

controls.name: WAVES tab
controls.does: Arena clock, a crowd from the roster at that minute, a swarm of one kind, the director run or held, an Elite or special now.

controls.name: ITEMS tab
controls.does: Every weapon (mutations and evolution stacked under it), evolution, line, passive, perk with - / + / max past the caps, INFO (what the player reads), EVO; Card look and Weapon looks rows.

controls.name: HERO tab
controls.does: Swap hero in place, the hero's looks as chips ('USE FROM NOW ON' keeps one), levels (+1, +5, +10, to 30), level-up cards on/off, god mode, heal, a hit, Go down (the real fall), gold, rerolls.

controls.name: DROPS tab
controls.does: Every power-up by the hero, a chest, a boss chest, gem or coin showers.

controls.name: WORLD tab
controls.does: Game speed, freeze the crowd, kill/remove everything, camera zoom, stats overlay, training dummies and attacking dummies, the field, 'Leave the arena' (asks 'Leave the arena?' 'Back to the title. Nothing done here is kept.', 'Leave' / 'Stay').

shows: Bottom sheet with six tabs (ENEMY, WAVES, ITEMS, HERO, DROPS, WORLD)
Art variants section with look chips (shelved looks behind a choice)
rules: A death respawns the hero at once (Game.arena_respawn) unless HERO's Go down.
The quick column keeps under the boss bar and the camera cutout.
Old UiKit look.

name: Upgrade (old meta shop forwarder)

purpose: Forwards an old route to the Upgrade board.

controls.name: Open Upgrade

shows: 'The shop is the Upgrade board now.'
